node.title: Re: get specific value of element using xpath in perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I want to retrieve value of <release-date> element where <title> having value 'Solaris' and not other title elements. ... I tired XPath something like my $title= $xp->find("/playlist/movie[title='Solaris']/release-date", $node); But result is not as expected OutPut ::2002-11-27

If the question is what is the of the movie with the </c> "Solaris", isn't the correct answer "2002-11-27"? Both [mod://XML::LibXML] and [mod://XML::XPath] seem to work fine for me with the exact XPath expression you've shown. <small><i><c><update></c></i></small> All that the code you showed seems to try to do is build an array of hashes containing the <c><title></c> elements' values, which doesn't seem to fit your problem statement. <small><i><c></update></c></i></small></p> <c> my $file = '/tmp/1193350.xml'; my $xpath = q{/playlist/movie[title='Solaris']/release-date}; use XML::LibXML; my $doc = XML::LibXML->load_xml(location=>$file); for my $node ( $doc->findnodes($xpath) ) { print "XML::LibXML: ",$node->textContent,"\n"; } use XML::XPath; my $xp = XML::XPath->new(filename=>$file); my $nodeset = $xp->find($xpath); for my $node ($nodeset->get_nodelist) { print " XML::XPath: ",$node->string_value,"\n"; } __END__ XML::LibXML: 2002-11-27 XML::XPath: 2002-11-27 </c>
